question: Explain the ASP.NET Core request processing pipeline and how Middleware components chain using RequestDelegate.
idealAnswer: ASP.NET Core processes HTTP requests through a pipeline of middleware components registered in Program.cs. Each middleware receives HttpContext and a next RequestDelegate to pass execution downstream.
ideal_answer: ASP.NET Core processes HTTP requests through a pipeline of middleware components registered in Program.cs. Each middleware receives HttpContext and a next RequestDelegate to pass execution downstream.
explanation: Evaluates ASP.NET Architecture and ASP.NET Core Middleware Pipeline comprehension.

question: Explain Dependency Injection (DI) in ASP.NET Core and the difference between Transient, Scoped, and Singleton lifetimes.
idealAnswer: Transient services are created each time requested. Scoped services are created once per client HTTP request. Singleton services are created once on initial request and shared application-wide across all requests.
ideal_answer: Transient services are created each time requested. Scoped services are created once per client HTTP request. Singleton services are created once on initial request and shared application-wide across all requests.
explanation: Evaluates ASP.NET Dependency Injection and Service Lifetimes (Transient, Scoped, Singleton) comprehension.

question: How does ASP.NET Core implement Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF/XSRF) prevention using Antiforgery tokens?
